question: The Khelo India Youth Games 2025 was organised from which date to which date at different locations in Bihar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4 to 15 May 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Khelo India Youth Games** (KIYG) is one of India’s flagship sports events aimed at promoting grassroots-level sports and identifying young talent across the country.
 
• The **Khelo India Youth Games 2025** were organized from **4 to 15 May 2025** at various locations in **Bihar**. This is the correct answer__.
 
• The event aims to provide a platform for young athletes to showcase their talent and encourages participation in sports from diverse regions of India.
 
• **Bihar** was chosen as the host state for the games in 2025 to promote sports culture and infrastructure development in the region.
 
• The games included participation from athletes across different states and union territories, competing in multiple sporting disciplines.
 
• The **Khelo India scheme** has been instrumental in nurturing young athletes, supporting them through scholarships, and providing access to high-quality training facilities.
 
• Several venues across **Bihar**, such as Patna, Gaya, and Bhagalpur, were utilized for different sports during the games.
 
• The games also focused on building awareness about sports and fitness among the youth, aligning with the **Khelo India initiative’s** goals of creating a fitter nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Program:**

 
 
• The **Khelo India Program** was launched by the Government of India in **2018** to improve sports infrastructure and encourage sports participation at grassroots levels.
 
• It includes initiatives like organizing events, scholarships for promising athletes, and infrastructure development in rural and urban areas.
 
• Under this program, young athletes are identified and supported through financial aid and professional coaching.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Bihar as Host State:**
 
 
• **Bihar** is increasingly focusing on promoting sports and fitness among its youth, with efforts to improve sports facilities and infrastructure.
 
• Hosting the **Khelo India Youth Games** provides an opportunity to showcase the state’s cultural and social diversity while boosting its sports ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Khelo India Youth Games:**
 
 
• The games help identify young talent who can represent India in international competitions like the Olympics, Commonwealth Games, and Asian Games.
 
• It also promotes a culture of sports and fitness as part of the **Fit India Movement** initiated by the Government of India.
 
• The games create opportunities for athletes from remote areas to compete on a national stage.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sports Infrastructure Development:**

 
 
• The games encourage states to invest in sports facilities, thereby boosting overall infrastructure development.
 
• Bihar’s hosting of the **Khelo India Youth Games 2025** indicates its commitment to improving sports facilities and providing opportunities for young athletes.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Dates:**
 
 
• The games were held over a span of **12 days**, from **4 to 15 May 2025**, ensuring a well-organized schedule for competitions.
 
• The choice of May as the month for the games aligns with favorable weather conditions and the availability of venues.
